rows.notRelevantBecause_da: Vi transporterer ikke køle- eller frostvarer.

rows.whatYouDo_da: Pizzaer og varme retter udbringes i isolerede tasker inden for 30 minutter.
rows.whatYouDo_en: Pizzas and hot dishes are delivered in insulated bags within 30 minutes.
rows.whatCanGoWrong_da: Maden falder i temperatur under lang udbringning.
rows.whatCanGoWrong_en: Food temperature drops during long deliveries.
rows.controlMeasures_da: Isolerede tasker; ruter planlægges så levering sker under 30 minutter.
rows.controlMeasures_en: Insulated bags; routes planned so delivery stays under 30 minutes.
rows.ifItGoesWrong_da: Forsinket mad ombages/erstattes frem for at blive leveret lunken.
rows.ifItGoesWrong_en: Delayed food is re-made/replaced rather than delivered lukewarm.

hazards.description_da: Bakterievækst i varm mad, der køler langsomt under udbringning.
hazards.description_en: Bacterial growth in hot food cooling slowly during delivery.
hazards.controlMeasure_en: Short delivery time and insulated bags.
hazards.justification_en: Deliveries stay in the local area.
